title: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXVII OF 1994
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXVII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 12th October, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-21/94, dated
12-10-1994.---The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1994 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 10th August, 1994 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 30th August, 1994 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(i) This Act may be called the
Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Second Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 16 of Sindh Ordinance No.XII of 1979

ACT XXVII OF 1994
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXVII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 12th October, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-21/94, dated
12-10-1994.---The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Bill, 1994 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 10th August, 1994 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 30th August, 1994 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 16 of Sindh Ordinance No.XII of 1979.--In
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979, in section 16 after subsection (2),
the following subsections shall be added:--
"(3) Where
any person or authority is appointed under subsection (2), Government may
appoint an Advisory Council consisting of such number of persons as it thinks
fit to perform such functions as Government may by notification assign to it.
(4) The Advisory
Council shall meet as often and in such manner as such person or Authority
deems fit.
(5) A member of
the Advisory Council shall hold office at the pleasure of Government but may at
any time resign from membership by addressing letter to Government.
(6) The person
or authority appointed under the proviso to subsection (2) shall appoint a
member of the Advisory Council or where no such Council is appointed such
person or authority may appoint any other person to exercise the powers and
perform the functions of the Chairman of a Panchayat. "
